engine: PostgreSQL 18.6 (PGlite 0.5.9) on wasm32-unknown-emscripten, compiled by emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 3.1.74 (1092ec30a3fb1d46b1782ff1b4db5094d3d06ae5), 32-bit
checks: all public tables have RLS
one announcement RPC with eight arguments
security-definer functions fix their search path
migration executor is not superuser and Storage ownership is preserved
activation internals and working-day helper deny app roles
private buckets and no direct portal writes
portal catalog has real foreign keys, exclusion and integrity triggers
invited, disabled, incomplete, inactive and unlinked sessions cannot read or write portal data
employee profile and manager roster obey role and department boundaries
attendance duration and own/department visibility execute correctly
task assignment, progress, manager review and timestamps execute successfully
leave submission is idempotent, caller-bound and overlap protected
only designated manager can see and decide leave; repeated decisions fail
required leave documents require actual owned objects and designated approver access
announcement drafts, publication and attachments follow department RLS
announcement replacement uses expected-path CAS and owner-only replacement
account disabling immediately revokes access despite outstanding work
relationship changes require rerouting and transferred uploaders lose old referenced documents
provisioning missing settings fails closed
synthetic provisioning creates valid department and approver links
provisioning exact rerun preserves profiles and conflicting identity rolls back
activation claim is service-only and unknown eligibility returns nothing
competing activation is cooled down and wrong lease cannot reconcile or link
valid activation prelinks as invited without exposing protected tables or lease fields
setup requires confirmed email and password; username collision rolls back activation
release cannot demote an activated profile and provisioning preserves setup state
disable during activation invalidates linking without resurrecting profile
invalid legacy data rolls back the fifth migration without partial hardening
limitations: Minimal Auth/Storage compatibility schemas, not a Supabase stack
No Auth API, SMTP, PostgREST, signed URLs or physical object storage tested
Single database connection; no simultaneous transaction/concurrency proof
Real Supabase migration-role permissions and managed-schema upgrades unverified
